nodes.label: Exact Installed Model String Convention
nodes.rationale: When dispatching subagents via agy CLI, do not pass short aliases; use exact installed model string like Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low).

nodes.label: Context-Scoped Overview Widgets
nodes.rationale: High-level overview banners (TimeRadarWidget, FocusHeroBanner, SmartSuggestionCard) must only render on top-level All Resources view to prevent distraction.

nodes.label: Visual Harmony & Clean Iconography
nodes.rationale: Folder cards must align icon, title, count, and actions using structured CSS Grid; preserve clean colored icon strokes without heavy background containers.
